subject: Revert "BaseTools: Add support for out-of-tree builds"
reasons: The commit is dominated by GNU make, shell wrapper, and Python changes rather than C source transformations.
Coccinelle targets C/C++ AST-level edits; most of this revert is outside that domain.
Even where changes repeat, the patterns are build-system specific (`BUILDROOT`/`OBJDIR` handling, path rewrites, wrapper logic), not C semantic collateral evolution.
This is a revert of an out-of-tree build design change, so the edits are tied to build-flow context across multiple file types rather than one reusable C before/after rule.
